gates.name: heaviside_equivalence
gates.message: constant-field eta reproduces FEniTop's scalar-eta Heaviside to 1e-12

gates.name: kl_correlation
gates.message: empirical correlation matches the analytic truncated correlation (max abs err 0.138 <= 0.176, of which 0.176 is the sampling-noise allowance over 528 entries at n=1000); truncation gap vs target kernel 0.225

detail.note: The sampled field is G(x)/std(x): the truncated KL field normalized to unit pointwise variance. Its covariance is the truncated CORRELATION, not sigma^2*exp(-r^2/2l^2); sigma cancels identically. max_abs_gap_truncated_vs_target_kernel is the cost of truncating at variance_explained and must be reported as a modelling approximation.

gates.name: eta_marginal
gates.message: realized eta matches Beta(2,2) on [0.25,0.75] at all 32 tested nodes (min p=0.0111 >= 0.000313)

gates.name: gradient_fd
gates.message: SAA adjoint matches central differences over 6 elements (max rel err dJ=0.00285, dE[V]=2.6e-05 <= 0.01)

detail.note: Checked against the SAME fixed sample set used for the analytic gradient, so J_N is deterministic and there is no Monte Carlo noise floor in this comparison.
